title: SubLiftVlmOcrSlotsResponse
description: Schema for slot-driven multimodal VLM OCR subtitle extraction output.

slots.description: Ordered list of transcribed timing slots matching the #NNN labels on the contact sheet.

id.description: 1-indexed slot ID matching the #NNN label on the left column of the contact sheet.

category.description: Semantic category of the visual text in the slot.

lines.description: Subtitle lines from top to bottom (empty array for empty/noise slots).
